page.title: Paychecks
page.intro: Your pay schedules and when you expect to get paid. Expected only; not included in your totals.
page.acknowledgeCreate: I checked my pay schedules. Let me try again

manual.heading: Add a pay schedule
manual.intro: You’re setting this up yourself. It isn’t based on deposits or confirmed by your employer.

groups.locked: Finish or cancel the open action before closing this group.

profiles.heading: Your pay schedules
profiles.emptyBody: Review a possible paycheck below or add a pay schedule manually. A deposit alone is not a confirmed paycheck.

suggestions.heading: Deposits that may match a pay schedule
suggestions.intro: Nothing is linked until you choose Link. Dismissing hides a match on this device only.
suggestions.unavailable: We couldn’t check your deposits for matches. The rest of this page still works.
suggestions.dateReason: The deposit date, {{date}}, is within the expected dates, {{from}}–{{to}}.
suggestions.amountFixedReason: The amount, {{amount}}, equals the expected amount.
suggestions.amountRangeReason: The amount, {{amount}}, is within the expected range, {{minimum}}–{{maximum}}.
suggestions.dismissedIntro: These matches are hidden on this device only. Show one again to bring it back.

candidates.heading: Possible paychecks
candidates.intro: Review the deposits before confirming a pay schedule.
candidates.none: No possible paychecks to review. You can still add a pay schedule manually.
candidates.dismissedIntro: Dismissing applies to the exact deposits you reviewed. Review a possible paycheck again to look at it once more.
candidates.dismissedLocked: Dismissed possible paychecks stay open while a decision is saving.

card.basedOnVariable: Based on {{total}} deposits. Past amounts, not an expected range.
card.noWindowActive: No expected dates available. Expected, not guaranteed.
card.noWindowPaused: Paused pay schedules have no expected dates.
card.noWindowEnded: Ended pay schedules have no expected dates.
card.scheduleNote: To change the pay dates, end this pay schedule and add a new one. Its linked deposits stay with it.

facts.sameAmount: The same amount in each deposit
facts.variableAmount: Varies · middle amount {{amount}} (from past deposits; not an expected range)

actions.endPrompt: End {{name}}? Its expected paychecks will stop. The pay schedule and its linked deposits stay, and you can turn it back on.

evidence.none: No linked deposits. This is your saved pay schedule.
evidence.edited: Edited since this deposit was linked. The pay schedule is unchanged.
evidence.removePrompt: Remove this deposit link? The deposit stays in Transactions.

receipt.label: Deposit to link to {{name}}
receipt.heading: Link a deposit
receipt.intro: Link a deposit you received to this pay schedule. Its expected amount and dates don’t change.
receipt.loadError: We couldn’t load your deposits. Cancel and try again.

warnings.dateOutsideWindow: This date is outside the expected dates. You can still use the actual deposit date.
warnings.amountNeedsReview: Exact amount unavailable for this deposit. Linking it won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.expectedAmountNeedsReview: Exact expected amount unavailable. Linking this deposit won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.differsFromFixed: This amount differs from the expected amount. You can still link this deposit.
warnings.expectedRangeNeedsReview: Exact expected range unavailable. Linking this deposit won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.outsideRange: This amount is outside the expected range. You can still link this deposit.

cashInErrors.amount: Enter an amount above zero with up to two decimals (maximum 9999999999999999.99).

form.manualNote: Create an active pay schedule for your expected paycheck. You’re setting this up yourself; it isn’t confirmed by your employer.
form.confirmScheduleNote: Review and accept these pay dates as they are. To use different dates, add a pay schedule manually.
form.editScheduleNote: The pay dates can’t be edited. End this pay schedule and add a new one to change them. Its linked deposits stay with it.
form.variableNote: The amounts in your deposits vary. Enter the lowest and highest amounts you expect. We don’t fill them in for you.
form.unsafeAmountNote: We couldn’t load the exact amount. Enter the exact amount you expect before saving.
form.submitError: We couldn’t finish that action. Check the message on the page before trying again.

fields.monthlyAnchorDay: Day of the month you’re paid
fields.firstAnchorDay: First pay day: day of the month
fields.secondAnchorDay: Second pay day: day of the month

hints.semimonthly: Two pay days a month, at least 7 days apart.

errors.display_name_invalid: Enter a display name of 1 to 500 characters.
errors.anchor_kind_invalid: Choose a day of month or month end.
errors.anchor_day_invalid: Enter a whole day from 1 to 30, or choose month end.
errors.reference_date_invalid: Enter a valid starting pay date.
errors.semimonthly_pair_invalid: Choose two pay days in order, at least 7 days apart (including in February).
errors.window_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3.
errors.amount_mode_invalid: Your pay varies, so enter the lowest and highest amounts you expect.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter an amount above zero with up to two decimals (maximum 9999999999999999.99).
errors.range_order_invalid: Maximum amount must be greater than minimum amount.

feedback.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your paychecks. Refresh to try again. What you see may be out of date.
feedback.uncertainCreate: We couldn’t confirm whether the pay schedule was saved. Refresh and check your pay schedules before trying again.
feedback.uncertainWrite: We couldn’t confirm whether that worked. Refresh and check what’s saved before trying again.
feedback.uncertainCreateLoaded: Paychecks reloaded. Check your pay schedules before adding another one.
feedback.uncertainReceiptLoaded: Paychecks reloaded. Check the linked deposits before linking another deposit.

notices.dismissed: Possible paycheck dismissed. You can review it again below.
notices.reconsidered: Possible paycheck added back to your list to review.
notices.receiptRecorded: Deposit linked to this pay schedule.
notices.receiptRemoved: Deposit link removed. The deposit stays in Transactions.

errors.authentication_required: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage paychecks.
errors.paycheck_not_found: That pay schedule is no longer available. Check the current pay schedules.
errors.candidate_changed: This possible paycheck changed or is no longer available. Check the latest deposits, then try again.
errors.candidate_dismissed: This possible paycheck was dismissed. Review it again before confirming it.
errors.confirmation_conflict: The deposits changed while you were confirming. Check the latest deposits, then try again.
errors.candidate_schedule_mismatch: The pay dates of a possible paycheck can’t be changed. Review it again, or add a pay schedule manually.
errors.fingerprint_invalid: This possible paycheck can no longer be reviewed. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.algorithm_version_invalid: This suggestion is out of date. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.name_invalid: Enter a pay schedule name of 1 to 500 characters.
errors.schedule_invalid: Enter a complete, valid pay schedule.
errors.timing_invalid: Enter whole days from 0 to 3 for days before and after.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter a fixed amount above zero, or a range from lowest to highest, with up to two decimals.
errors.paycheck_not_active: Only an active pay schedule can link a new deposit.
errors.receipt_slot_unavailable: That paycheck date is no longer available. Check the refreshed pay schedule.
errors.receipt_source_invalid: Choose either a new deposit or a saved deposit.
errors.receipt_inflow_invalid: Enter a description, an amount above zero, and a valid date.
errors.receipt_inflow_unavailable: That deposit is unavailable or already linked. Check the refreshed deposits.
errors.receipt_conflict: That deposit changed or is already linked. Check the updated pay schedule.
errors.receipt_link_protected: Links from the confirmation history can’t be removed here.
errors.receipt_date_invalid: That deposit date is too far from the selected paycheck date.
errors.request_invalid: Check the form fields and try again.
errors.request_failed: We couldn’t complete that request. Try again.
